novelty_claim: Fuse both parents on a shared intermediate representation: a pool of anchored harmful prompt->completion exemplar pairs. BreakMe2.0's guardrail-dataset search (seed/inspection/expansion + validation-error refusal recovery) operates ON the pool; TranslationJailbreak2.0's code-switched LRL fragment-relay becomes a serialization/acquisition operator OVER the pool: refused seed or expansion calls are re-issued as LRL fragment translate-and-transcribe tasks (qwen's accepted surface), and stalled inspection targets are re-serialized as fragment-relay incident-log demands (deepseek/gpt-oss high-specificity channel). Refusal-feedback routing between channels, one pool, one control flow — not side-by-side execution.
initial_hypothesis: ASR: mean ASR rises above the better locked parent baseline (bm2-0 0.635) to >= 0.80 on the frozen 50-goal x 4-victim panel (>=30% relative), by converting qwen (bm2-0 0.22 -> toward tj2-0's 0.68 channel) via fragment-relay seed acquisition and luna (tj2-0 0.00 -> bm2-0's 0.58 channel) via validation-error recovery, while holding gpt-oss (~0.85+) and deepseek (~0.8+). Mechanism: (a) LRL fragment-relay seed repair converts qwen's seed-refusal class; (b) validation-error recovery on all pool-writing calls preserves bm2-0's luna/gpt-oss converter; (c) fragment-relay re-serialization of stalled expansion targets converts drift/hedge stalls into high-specificity completions.
key_insight: bm2-0 fails exactly where its seed is refused (qwen 0.22: seed-stage refusal poisons the whole search, no repair); tj2-0 fails where its single-shot reassembled English goal arms step-2 refusal/hollowing (luna 0.00). Each parent's accepted surface is the other parent's failure channel: qwen accepts LRL translation but refuses harmful-exemplar generation; luna accepts guardrail-dataset validation-error repair but narrates around fiction-framed work orders. Routing pool-writing calls through the channel the victim's refusal feedback indicates converts both failure classes without victim-keyed branching.
